presets.label: Everything we can detect
presets.summary: Every detector, and the contextual pass unrestricted.
looksFor: Email addresses, telephone numbers and postal addresses
Names of people, and organizations named as a customer or patient
Government identifiers, payment cards, bank and account numbers
Dates of birth, customer and case references
Credentials, API keys and links carrying a token
Faces and signatures in images

presets.label: Names and contact details
presets.summary: The things that identify a person directly, and nothing else.
looksFor: Names of people
Email addresses and telephone numbers
Postal and street addresses
Faces and signatures in images

presets.label: Identifiers and dates
presets.summary: Reference numbers and dates that pin a record to a person.
looksFor: Government identifiers, such as a Social Security number
Customer, client, member, policy, case and patient references
Dates labelled as a date of birth

presets.label: Payment and account numbers
presets.summary: Money: cards, bank accounts, and the numbers that reach them.
looksFor: Payment card numbers that pass the Luhn check
IBANs
Numbers labelled as an account or sort code
Financial facts tied to a named party

presets.label: Credentials and keys
presets.summary: What leaks out of engineering documents: secrets and private links.
looksFor: API keys, tokens and provider credential formats
Links carrying a token, an invite or a reset path
Text marked confidential or internal
